en.body:
When the name **Jonathan Banks** comes up, most fans immediately picture the unflappable, morally ambiguous fixer **Mike Ehrmantraut** from **Breaking Bad** and **Better Call Saul**. His gravelly voice and steely gaze became iconic, a cornerstone of some of television's most acclaimed dramas. However, before he was cleaning up messes for drug kingpins or dispensing wisdom with a world-weary sigh, Banks honed his craft in the often-unpredictable world of 90s television comedy.

Many might not recall, but **Jonathan Banks** actually starred in a forgotten 90s sitcom titled **Otherworld**. While details about his specific role in the show are sparse, this stint in a comedic setting stands in stark contrast to the hard-boiled characters he's most celebrated for today. It’s a fascinating glimpse into an actor’s diverse career, proving that even the most hardened on-screen personas often have roots in lighter fare. His earlier work also included a notable role as FBI Special Agent Frank McPike in the 1987–1990 series **Wiseguy**, for which he earned a Primetime Emmy nomination, showcasing his dramatic range even before his iconic turn as Mike.

## A Different Kind of Role

While **Breaking Bad** and its prequel **Better Call Saul** catapulted **Jonathan Banks** to global recognition, his career spans decades and genres. The actor, born January 31, 1947, has a rich history in television that predates his most famous roles. The existence of **Otherworld** offers a compelling narrative arc for fans who have followed Banks' journey. It highlights how actors often explore different facets of their talent before finding the roles that define them in the popular consciousness. For binge-watchers and series aficionados, discovering these less-traveled paths in an actor's filmography adds another layer of appreciation for their artistry.

## What This Means for Fans

For the legions of fans who adore **Mike Ehrmantraut**, this peek into Banks' comedic past is a delightful revelation. It reframes the character slightly, reminding viewers that the man behind the gruff exterior has a broad acting spectrum. It’s a testament to his versatility that he can embody both the stoic, dangerous Mike and, presumably, a character in a 90s sitcom with equal conviction. This information adds valuable context to his career trajectory, especially as he reprised his role as Mike, a character who became a central figure alongside **Giancarlo Esposito's** Gus Fring in the **Breaking Bad** universe.

## What's Next

While **Jonathan Banks** continues to be a sought-after actor, specific details about his future projects following his tenure in the **Breaking Bad** universe have not yet been announced. Fans can revisit his extensive body of work, including **Wiseguy**, **Breaking Bad**, and **Better Call Saul**, to appreciate the full scope of his career.

content_raw: Jonathan Banks may have made his name as a tough, no-nonsense antihero, but his roots lie in comedy - and he even spent some time in the world of sitcoms.
